added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arm logs on disk: flat-pin-delivery/base-test_support_read.log at 5f8e4a26 ends '13 passed, 2 skipped' with EXIT=0 and no FAILED line, and flat-pin-delivery/head-test_bank_traced_inputs.log at 7ce819df ends '7 passed in 252.96s' with EXIT=0, so the after arm adds no failure id over the base arm; the base and head arms of the three pre-existing files (13 passed 2 skipped, 10 passed, 11 passed) also add none.

findings.text: non-blocking: the traced residual is checked against bank.step_residual(effective, ...) where effective is produced by the same driven_operands call the traced path makes inside step_residual, so a defect in driven_operands (for example masking the wrong coil column) leaves both sides equally wrong and the assertion true; the only independent guard on the coil path is the axis-shift assertion at line 254.

non-blocking: every fixture builds coil_exterior with a single coil column (the coils at line 37, the zeros at line 75) and coil_count 1, so the per-coil einsum and the coil_count mask are never exercised with two live coils; a swapped coil order or an off-by-one in the masked column would not be caught.

non-blocking: the density_gradient getattr that routes a tabulated profile's analytic derivative into book_tangent and book_tangent_channels has no test that reddens if it is removed; the derivative test at tests/test_bank_traced_inputs.py:153 exercises TabulatedProfile.density_gradient in isolation, and the pin test would still converge on the constant-gradient fallback.

non-blocking: the pin assertion measures the landed centroid with support_read.py:2323 _centroid_height, the same helper the solver's centroid row uses at support_read.py:2488, and the solve starts from zero moments where the centroid is undefined, so an error in that formula or a start that leaks the target into the initial state would not redden the 1e-8 tolerance.

non-blocking: the evidence record carries no figure, although the declared write paths include docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-traced-inputs and the repository requires a forward-solve evidence record to show its terminal poloidal flux contour panels with both null sets and the wall; the zero plasma-response fixture limits what the panel would show, and the scenario node renders the coupled state.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is traced per-lane coil currents and tabulated p'/FF' with a weak centroid pin on the bank route; nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:175 driven_operands contracts coil_exterior with a per-lane current vector, nova/equilibrium/current.py:63 TabulatedProfile carries the 33-knot tables, and support_read.py:2350 adds the bordered pin, all reachable from solve_batch.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports status complete at 7ce819dfc048648540ca6ee6acbbca0008482c70, the flat-pin-delivery gate logs with EXIT lines, the closure-mutant log, and the numerics receipt.

justifications.durability: the closure mutation is a genuine negative control (closure-mutant.log shows assert 1 == 0 at EXIT=1), but tests/test_bank_traced_inputs.py:255 compares the traced residual against the same driven_operands output the traced path produces, and nothing fails if current.py:606 or :757 drops the tabulated density_gradient from the booking tangents.
justifications.evidence: flat-pin-delivery/head-test_bank_traced_inputs.log ends 7 passed and EXIT=0 with SLICE_COMPILATIONS cold 1 changed 0, and flat-pin-cold-start/numerics.log records changed_compiles 0 with a module path and revision.
justifications.fit: the added symbols (driven_operands, TabulatedProfile, _centroid_height) name their mechanism and follow the surrounding style of support_read.py:201 and current.py:32, though the getattr fallback idiom at support_read.py:1408 and current.py:606 states a profile protocol implicitly.
justifications.goal_fidelity: support_read.py:175 driven_operands and :2350 _solve_pinned_lane land the three named inputs, but the pin is only shown holding a centroid it starts undefined at (zero-current start), so its hold-from-displaced behaviour is asserted nowhere.
justifications.reuse: current.TabulatedProfile reuses convention.toroidal_current_density and the existing clipped_support_current_moments profile seam, and _solve_pinned_lane reuses constraint.VerticalPositionPin; a search for an existing jax-differentiable normalized-flux interpolator (nova/imas/profiles.py is scipy host-side) and for a cell-moment-to-centroid helper found no owner, so _tabulated_value and _centroid_height are first of their capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: all seven paths in the diff are inside the write paths declared at the manifest's orientation_write_paths, and the only additions outside them are none.
